title: EFC — Mathematical Framework for Energy Flow in Space-Time
abstract: Introduces Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC) as a theoretical framework where an energy-flow vector field interacts with entropy and standard relativistic boundary conditions to shape space-time dynamics. The work proposes integrating energy-flow effects into Einstein’s field equations and outlines qualitative predictions for cosmic expansion in low-density regions, black hole horizon stability, and temporal coherence of quantum fluctuations.
